question: The first Indian woman powerlifter who participated in the Tokyo Paralympics 2020 was ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sakina Khatun**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sakina Khatun:-**

 
 
• She is a native of West Bengal, India. She started powerlifting in 2013 and has since won several medals at the national and international levels.
 
• She won a gold medal at the 2019 Asian Para Powerlifting Championships and a silver medal at the 2019 World Para Powerlifting Championships.
 
• **The first Indian woman powerlifter who participated in the Tokyo Paralympics 2020 was Sakina Khatun. **
 
• **She competed in the women's 50 kg category and finished in sixth place.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Tokyo Paralympics 2020:-**

 
 
• The Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games were held from August 24 to September 5, 2021, in Tokyo, Japan.
 
• They were the 16th Summer Paralympic Games as organized by the International Paralympic Committee (IPC).
 
• Despite the challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic, the Tokyo Paralympics were a resounding success, with over 4,400 athletes from 162 countries competing in 539 medal events across 22 sports.
